description: Synthetic market-data generator config (iap.marketdata.generator). All randomness is SplitMix64 seeded from `seed`; identical seed => bit-identical output files. Equities: ONE shared regime-switching efficient price per instrument (sigma per sqrt-second, 1s grid) with per-venue bounded AR(1) microstructure noise (`venue_noise`) and self-exciting MBO flow, so the consolidated multi-venue book stays uncrossed; FX streams are QUOTE+TRADE across LP1/LP2/PRI. `anomalies` are injected for QC testing and disabled for golden vectors.
